title: PipelineSummaryResponse
description: A pipeline as returned by GET /api/pipelines, GET /api/pipelines/:id and the create/rename responses. `lastRun*` describe the latest non-dry run. `lastRunStepRowCounts` (HEL-1579) is that run's per-step row counts keyed by step id; it is omitted when not recorded (a never-run pipeline, a latest run that failed, was blocked or reaped, a Spark run, or a run that predates the column) and is never rendered as zero. `fingerprint` and `definition` (HEL-1629) are present only on the single-pipeline read.

lastRunStepRowCounts.description: Step id to the number of rows that step produced in the latest run. Omitted or null when not recorded.

fingerprint.description: Present ONLY on GET /api/pipelines/:id (HEL-1629): the `pipeline` fingerprint (name, tag, roots, steps, Outputs with their bound panel ids and alert rules, schedule) that POST /api/pipelines/:id/draft/save compares inside its own transaction. Computed on one read-only REPEATABLE READ snapshot. The list never carries it.

definition.description: Present only on GET /api/pipelines/:id?definition=true (HEL-1629): the steps and Outputs the `fingerprint` was computed from, read from the SAME snapshot. This is what a draft is based on.
